mapper.select: select A.BOOKSET_ID booksetId, A.BUSI_ID finprodId, a.portfolio_id portfolioId, a.portfolio_name portfolioName, a.INV_AIM invAim, fp.trade_market tradeMarket, nvl(fp.finprod_Name,fp.finprod_abbr) finprodName, decode(ftp.type_8,'F02','02','F11','06','F01','01','F04','10','F09','11') secType, a.institution_code instCode, fp.CALENDAR_ID calenderId from ( /*前一天的持仓头寸*/ select distinct A.BOOKSET_ID, A.BUSI_ID, A.INV_AIM, a.portfolio_id, a.portfolio_name, a.institution_code from( select bsdp.*, pp.portfolio_id, pp.portfolio_name, sd.institution_code, rank() over(partition by BOOKSET_ID,BOK_DETAIL_ID order by BOOK_SUMMARY_ORDER desc)rn from BOK_STAT_DET_POSIITON bsdp left join ptl_portfolio pp on (case when bsdp.BOOKSET_ID like '%_F28_%' THEN regexp_replace(substr(bsdp.BOOKSET_ID,0, INSTR(bsdp.BOOKSET_ID, '_F28_', 1, 1)-1), '^F16_','') else regexp_replace(bsdp.BOOKSET_ID, '^F16_','') end ) = pp.portfolio_id left join sys_department sd on nvl(pp.create_dept,bsdp.create_dept) = sd.dept_code where bsdp.BOOK_DATE = #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE}-1 and bsdp.HAPPEN_DATE = #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE}-1 and bsdp.POS_AMT!=0 )a union /*当天的交易所涉及的资产*/ select distinct bda.bookset_id, deal.finprod_id, deal.inv_aim, pp.portfolio_id, pp.portfolio_name, sd.institution_code from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal inner join BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING bda on bda.busi_no = deal.trade_Id and bda.BUSI_TABLE = '02' left join trd_product_deal_add tpda on tpda.trade_id = deal.trade_id left join ptl_portfolio pp on (case when bda.BOOKSET_ID like '%_F28_%' then regexp_replace(substr(bda.BOOKSET_ID,0, INSTR(bda.BOOKSET_ID, '_F28_', 1, 1)-1), '^F16_','') else regexp_replace(bda.BOOKSET_ID, '^F16_','') end) = pp.portfolio_id or (case when tpda.portfolio_id like '%_F28_%' then regexp_replace(substr(tpda.portfolio_id,0, INSTR(tpda.portfolio_id, '_F28_', 1, 1)-1), '^F16_','') else regexp_replace(tpda.portfolio_id, '^F16_','') end) = pp.portfolio_id left join sys_department sd on nvl(pp.create_dept,deal.create_dept) = sd.dept_code where deal.trade_date = #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE} )A inner join fin_product fp on fp.finprod_id = A.busi_id inner join fin_product_type ftp on ftp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where ftp.type_8 in ('F02','F11','F01','F04','F09')
